# Agent instructions: finance_spoke
Generated by lkagent from LookML and the business glossary (agent_instructions.v1, content hash 8deb5622b03c). Edits are overwritten on the next compile.

Rules are listed hub layer first, then spoke layer. Each rule ID is stable.

## Layer hub:core_hub

### default_filter
- [default_filter.invoices_base.invoices.is_void] In explores built on invoices_base, always filter Is Void (invoices.is_void) = "no" unless the user explicitly asks otherwise. Voided invoices never count as revenue.

### exclusion
- [exclusion.invoices_base] Explores built on invoices_base (Invoices) always exclude rows: Internal QA account. Always excluded from reporting; Soft-deleted order. Always excluded from reporting. Never include them, even when asked for all data.
- [exclusion.orders_base] Explores built on orders_base (Orders) always exclude rows: Internal QA account. Always excluded from reporting; Soft-deleted order. Always excluded from reporting. Never include them, even when asked for all data.

### metric_definition
- [metric.invoices.recognized_revenue] Recognized Revenue (invoices.recognized_revenue) is the certified definition of Recognized Revenue. Invoiced amount (net of discounts) recognized on the invoice date, excluding void invoices.
- [metric.orders.active_customer_count] Active Customers (orders.active_customer_count) is the certified definition of Active Customer. Distinct customers with at least one order in the period.
- [metric.orders.gross_revenue] Gross Revenue (orders.gross_revenue) is the certified definition of Gross Revenue. Sum of order line amounts before discounts and refunds.
- [metric.orders.net_revenue] Net Revenue (orders.net_revenue) is the certified definition of Net Revenue. Gross revenue minus discounts minus refunds, attributed to the order date (late refunds reduce the period of the original order).
- [metric.orders.order_count] Order Count (orders.order_count) is the certified definition of Order Count. Number of orders (excluding test accounts and soft-deleted orders).

### pii_guardrail
- [pii.customers.billing_address] Never return Billing Address (customers.billing_address; personal data: address). If asked for it, refuse or answer without it.
- [pii.customers.contact_name] Never return Contact Name (customers.contact_name; personal data: name). If asked for it, refuse or answer without it.
- [pii.customers.date_of_birth] Never return Contact Date of Birth (customers.date_of_birth; personal data: dob). If asked for it, refuse or answer without it.
- [pii.customers.email] Never return Contact Email (customers.email; personal data: email). If asked for it, refuse or answer without it.
- [pii.customers.phone] Never return Contact Phone (customers.phone; personal data: phone). If asked for it, refuse or answer without it.

### time_convention
- [time.default.invoices_base] In explores built on invoices_base, the default time field is invoices.invoice (Invoice): Invoice date, which is the revenue recognition date. Use invoice_fiscal.fiscal_quarter_label / invoice_fiscal.fiscal_year for fiscal periods.
- [time.default.orders_base] In explores built on orders_base, the default time field is orders.created (Order Created): When the order was placed (UTC). Use the Order Fiscal Period fields for fiscal reporting. Use created_fiscal.fiscal_quarter_label / created_fiscal.fiscal_year for fiscal periods.
- [time.fiscal.fiscal_calendar] Harborline fiscal calendar. The fiscal year starts February 1 and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (FY2026 = 2025-02-01 to 2026-01-31). 'Last quarter' means the last completed fiscal quarter. Relative periods always mean completed periods: "last quarter" = last_completed_fiscal_quarter, "last fiscal quarter" = last_completed_fiscal_quarter, "previous quarter" = last_completed_fiscal_quarter, "last year" = last_completed_fiscal_year, "last fiscal year" = last_completed_fiscal_year, "last month" = last_completed_month.

### vocabulary
- [vocab.active_customer] "active customer", "active customers", "buying customers" all mean Active Customer: A non-test customer with at least one non-deleted order in the period. Use orders.active_customer_count.
- [vocab.customer] "customer", "customer name", "account" all mean Customer: A business that buys from Harborline, identified by its legal company name. Use customers.company_name.
- [vocab.customer_segment] "customer segment", "segment" all mean Customer Segment: Enterprise, Mid-Market or SMB, based on annual spend band. Use customers.segment.
- [vocab.fiscal_quarter] "fiscal quarter", "quarter", "fiscal qtr" all mean Fiscal Quarter: A three-month period of the Harborline fiscal year, which starts February 1. "Last quarter" means the last completed fiscal quarter. Use fiscal_calendar.fiscal_quarter_label.
- [vocab.fiscal_year] "fiscal year", "fy" all mean Fiscal Year: February 1 to January 31, named by the calendar year in which it ends (FY2026 = Feb 2025 to Jan 2026). Use fiscal_calendar.fiscal_year.
- [vocab.gross_revenue] "gross revenue", "gross sales", "bookings" all mean Gross Revenue: Sum of order line amounts before discounts and refunds. Use orders.gross_revenue.
- [vocab.net_revenue] "net revenue", "revenue", "sales", "net sales", "turnover" all mean Net Revenue: Gross order revenue minus discounts minus refunds, attributed to the order date. This is the company's default meaning of "revenue" and "sales". Use orders.net_revenue.
- [vocab.order_count] "order count", "orders", "number of orders", "order volume" all mean Order Count: Number of orders, excluding test accounts and soft-deleted orders. Use orders.order_count.
- [vocab.recognized_revenue] "recognized revenue", "invoiced revenue", "billed revenue" all mean Recognized Revenue: Invoiced amount recognized on the invoice date, excluding void invoices. Use invoices.recognized_revenue.
- [vocab.region] "region", "sales region", "territory" all mean Region: Sales region of the customer. "Pacific NW" is a legacy spelling of "Pacific Northwest". Use regions.region_name.

## Layer spoke:finance_spoke

### metric_definition
- [metric.orders.refund_rate] Refund Rate (orders.refund_rate) is the definition of Refund Rate. Refunds attributed to the order period divided by gross revenue.
- [metric.payments.days_sales_outstanding] Days Sales Outstanding (payments.days_sales_outstanding) is the definition of Days Sales Outstanding. Average number of days from invoice date to payment date for paid invoices.

### vocabulary
- [vocab.days_sales_outstanding] "days sales outstanding", "dso", "days to pay" all mean Days Sales Outstanding: Average days from invoice date to payment date for paid invoices. Use payments.days_sales_outstanding.
- [vocab.refund_rate] "refund rate", "refund percentage" all mean Refund Rate: Refunds attributed to the order period divided by gross revenue. Use orders.refund_rate.
